summary: Tested country flags, admin Signup insights and the Travel eSIM QR / phone number. Backend: 8 of 9 pytest tests pass. Admin insights works: auth is checked, the response has the right shape, days=7/30/90 works, a bad value falls back to 30, and a new signup with a utm source, campaign and purpose is counted. Order fields come back correctly and cost/idemKey/chatId are hidden. FAILED: Travel eSIM zones have code=null for all 187 zones. Frontend: flags render as span.fi (no emoji) on International Texting, My numbers cards, number detail, Messages thread list and header (uxtest: +31 NL, +1416 CA), number Call log desktop table and phone cards (390 wide), dashboard activity, and Travel eSIM order cards. The eSIM order card shows a QR SVG plus 'eSIM number +3197000000000' for a temporary non-dryRun order (now deleted). Admin Signup insights UI shows every stat and bar list. The 7/30/90 buttons refetch (requests seen: days=7, days=90). A UI signup from /cloudivr/?utm_source=insighttest&utm_campaign=insightcamp that picked Fax appeared in sources, campaigns and purposes. Regression: the iter275 pytest suite passes 16 of 16. Onboarding and Home loaded during the UI signup. No console errors.

critical.issue: Every zone has code=null, so there is no flag on the zone buttons, plan header or order cards for new orders. RCA: travel-esim.js catalog() reads o.zone?.countries, but Bird /v1/esim/offers returns only zone_id (offer keys: created_at,id,name,phone,pricing,product,revision,speed,stackable,status,zone_id). Countries are only on GET /v1/esim/zones (paginated; e.g. {id:'ezn_...', name:'South Africa', countries:['ZA'], type:'local'}). Fix: in catalog(), page through /zones (limit=100, next_cursor) and build a zone_id->countries map. Then set code = countries.length===1 ? countries[0] : null. After deploying, clear or restart the 6h in-memory cache.

minor.issue: webEvents are sorted at:1 and capped with limit(200000). Past 200k events the NEWEST ones are dropped, so the funnel and exits for recent days become wrong. Sort descending, or aggregate in Mongo.
Visitor exits include admin and test paths ('/cloudivr/admin' is the top row, '/x'). Exclude /admin paths, or skip page_view tracking on the admin app.

Funnel 'Signed up' shows 247% of 'Visited the site' (47 vs 19) because signups made before tracking started have no visit events. Count only signups whose anon id has a page_view, or label the row clearly.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED BY TESTER. The flag drew ABOVE the select (42px off-centre, its own line) instead of inside it. flag-icons CSS '.fi{position:relative}' loads after Tailwind and overrode 'absolute'. Changed it to '!absolute'. Verified that address-country-select (profile dialog) and quick-call-nocc-select (CountryFix) now centre the flag 12px from the left with padding-left 40px and no text overlap. fax-buy-country-select uses the same component (not reached in UI because the profile gate blocks it).

The component is never imported or rendered anywhere in the frontend, now or in git history. The ready-to-text-<CC>-<type> buttons therefore never appear on Get a number, and the flag change there has no effect.

The lookup result card has a flag (code review), but the 'Recent lookups' rows (lookup-history-<i>) have no flag. Live lookup not run because it is a real paid provider call and is not simulated in preview.

integration_issues.issue: Zone buttons and the plan header show no flag (Plane icon fallback). Order cards for real orders also show none, because the backend sends code=null (see backend critical).

issues: A long unbroken SMS body (uxtest 'TEST xxxx…') overflows the card. Page scrollWidth was 1041 at 390 wide. Add break-words/break-all to the details text.
